verses.original: כִּ֤י יִגְנֹֽב־ אִישׁ֙ שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־ שֶׂ֔ה וּטְבָח֖וֹ א֣וֹ מְכָר֑וֹ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בָקָ֗ר יְשַׁלֵּם֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשּׁ֔וֹר וְאַרְבַּע־ צֹ֖אן תַּ֥חַת הַשֶּֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: kî yiḡ·nōḇ- ’îš šō·wr ’ōw- śeh ū·ṭə·ḇā·ḥōw ’ōw mə·ḵā·rōw ḥă·miš·šāh ḇā·qār yə·šal·lêm ta·ḥaṯ haš·šō·wr wə·’ar·ba‘- ṣōn ta·ḥaṯ haś·śeh
verses.literal: If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters or sells it he must repay five oxen for . . . an ox and four sheep for a sheep

verses.original: אִם־ בַּמַּחְתֶּ֛רֶת יִמָּצֵ֥א הַגַּנָּ֖ב וְהֻכָּ֣ה וָמֵ֑ת אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- bam·maḥ·te·reṯ yim·mā·ṣê hag·gan·nāḇ wə·huk·kāh wā·mêṯ ’ên lōw dā·mîm
verses.literal: If a thief is caught breaking in and is beaten to death no one shall be guilty of bloodshed

verses.original: אִם־ זָרְחָ֥ה הַשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ עָלָ֖יו דָּמִ֣ים ל֑וֹ שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם אִם־ אֵ֣ין ל֔וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֖ר בִּגְנֵבָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- zā·rə·ḥāh haš·še·meš ‘ā·lāw dā·mîm lōw šal·lêm yə·šal·lêm ’im- ’ên lōw wə·nim·kar biḡ·nê·ḇā·ṯōw
verses.literal: But if it happens after sunrise . . . . . . there is guilt for his bloodshed . . . A thief must make full restitution . . . if he has nothing he himself shall be sold for his theft

verses.original: אִֽם־ הִמָּצֵא֩ תִמָּצֵ֨א בְיָד֜וֹ הַגְּנֵבָ֗ה מִשּׁ֧וֹר עַד־ חֲמ֛וֹר עַד־ שֶׂ֖ה חַיִּ֑ים שְׁנַ֖יִם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- him·mā·ṣê ṯim·mā·ṣê ḇə·yā·ḏōw hag·gə·nê·ḇāh miš·šō·wr ‘aḏ- ḥă·mō·wr ‘aḏ- śeh ḥay·yîm šə·na·yim yə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: If what was stolen . . . is actually found . . . alive in his possession whether ox or donkey or sheep he must pay back double

verses.original: כִּ֤י יַבְעֶר־ אִישׁ֙ שָׂדֶ֣ה אוֹ־ כֶ֔רֶם וְשִׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ בְּעִירֹה וּבִעֵ֖ר בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר מֵיטַ֥ב שָׂדֵ֛הוּ וּמֵיטַ֥ב כַּרְמ֖וֹ יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî yaḇ·‘er- ’îš śā·ḏeh ’ōw- ḵe·rem wə·šil·laḥ ’eṯ- bə·ʿī·rōh ū·ḇi·‘êr biś·ḏêh ’a·ḥêr mê·ṭaḇ śā·ḏê·hū ū·mê·ṭaḇ kar·mōw yə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and allows them to stray so that they graze in someone else’s field he must make restitution from the best of his own field . . . or vineyard

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֵצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ וּמָצְאָ֤ה קֹצִים֙ וְנֶאֱכַ֣ל גָּדִ֔ישׁ א֥וֹ הַקָּמָ֖ה א֣וֹ הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם הַמַּבְעִ֖ר אֶת־ הַבְּעֵרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯê·ṣê ’êš ū·mā·ṣə·’āh qō·ṣîm wə·ne·’ĕ·ḵal gā·ḏîš ’ōw haq·qā·māh ’ōw haś·śā·ḏeh šal·lêm yə·šal·lêm ham·maḇ·‘ir ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ê·rāh
verses.literal: If a fire breaks out and spreads to thornbushes so that it consumes stacked or standing grain or the whole field the one who started the fire must make full restitution . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֜הוּ כֶּ֤סֶף אֽוֹ־ כֵלִים֙ לִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְגֻנַּ֖ב מִבֵּ֣ית הָאִ֑ישׁ אִם־ יִמָּצֵ֥א הַגַּנָּ֖ב יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yit·tên ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū ke·sep̄ ’ōw- ḵê·lîm liš·mōr wə·ḡun·naḇ mib·bêṯ hā·’îš ’im- yim·mā·ṣê hag·gan·nāḇ yə·šal·lêm šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: If a man . . . gives his neighbor money or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house the thief if caught must pay back double

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֤א יִמָּצֵא֙ הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְנִקְרַ֥ב בַּֽעַל־ הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים אִם־ לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖וֹ בִּמְלֶ֥אכֶת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō yim·mā·ṣê hag·gan·nāḇ wə·niq·raḇ ba·‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’im- lō šā·laḥ yā·ḏōw bim·le·ḵeṯ rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: If the thief is not found the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether . . . he has taken . . . his neighbor’s property

verses.original: עַֽל־ כָּל־ דְּבַר־ פֶּ֡שַׁע עַל־ שׁ֡וֹר עַל־ חֲ֠מוֹר עַל־ שֶׂ֨ה עַל־ שַׂלְמָ֜ה עַל־ כָּל־ אֲבֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ כִּי־ ה֣וּא זֶ֔ה עַ֚ד הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יָבֹ֖א דְּבַר־ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַרְשִׁיעֻן֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kāl- də·ḇar- pe·ša‘ ‘al- šō·wr ‘al- ḥă·mō·wr ‘al- śeh ‘al- śal·māh ‘al- kāl- ’ă·ḇê·ḏāh ’ă·šer yō·mar kî- hū zeh ‘aḏ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·ḇō də·ḇar- šə·nê·hem ’ă·šer yar·šî·‘un ’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·šal·lêm šə·na·yim lə·rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox . . . a donkey . . . a sheep . . . a garment . . . or any lost item that someone claims . . . This is mine both parties shall bring their cases before the judges The one whom the judges find guilty must pay back double to his neighbor

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֜הוּ חֲמ֨וֹר אוֹ־ שׁ֥וֹר אוֹ־ שֶׂ֛ה וְכָל־ בְּהֵמָ֖ה לִשְׁמֹ֑ר וּמֵ֛ת אוֹ־ נִשְׁבַּ֥ר אוֹ־ נִשְׁבָּ֖ה אֵ֥ין רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yit·tên ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū ḥă·mō·wr ’ōw- šō·wr ’ōw- śeh wə·ḵāl bə·hê·māh liš·mōr ū·mêṯ ’ōw- niš·bar ’ōw- niš·bāh ’ên rō·’eh
verses.literal: If a man . . . gives a donkey an ox a sheep or any other animal to be cared for by his neighbor but it dies or is injured or stolen while no one is watching

verses.original: שְׁבֻעַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה תִּהְיֶה֙ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אִם־ לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖וֹ בִּמְלֶ֣אכֶת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְלָקַ֥ח בְּעָלָ֖יו וְלֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ḇu·‘aṯ Yah·weh tih·yeh bên šə·nê·hem ’im- lō šā·laḥ yā·ḏōw bim·le·ḵeṯ rê·‘ê·hū wə·lā·qaḥ bə·‘ā·lāw wə·lō yə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: an oath before the LORD shall be made between the parties to determine whether or not the man has taken . . . his neighbor’s property The owner must accept the oath and require no restitution

verses.original: וְאִם־ גָּנֹ֥ב יִגָּנֵ֖ב מֵעִמּ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לִבְעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- gā·nōḇ yig·gā·nêḇ mê·‘im·mōw yə·šal·lêm liḇ·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: But if the animal was actually stolen from the neighbor he must make restitution to the owner

verses.original: אִם־ טָרֹ֥ף יִטָּרֵ֖ף יְבִאֵ֣הוּ עֵ֑ד הַטְּרֵפָ֖ה לֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’im- ṭā·rōp̄ yiṭ·ṭā·rêp̄ yə·ḇi·’ê·hū ‘êḏ haṭ·ṭə·rê·p̄āh lō yə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: If the animal was torn to pieces . . . he shall bring it as evidence he need not make restitution for the torn carcass

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִשְׁאַ֥ל אִ֛ישׁ מֵעִ֥ם רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְנִשְׁבַּ֣ר אוֹ־ מֵ֑ת בְּעָלָ֥יו אֵין־ עִמּ֖וֹ שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yiš·’al ’îš mê·‘im rê·‘ê·hū wə·niš·bar ’ōw- mêṯ bə·‘ā·lāw ’ên- ‘im·mōw šal·lêm yə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while its owner is not present he must make full restitution . . .

verses.original: אִם־ בְּעָלָ֥יו עִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם אִם־ שָׂכִ֣יר ה֔וּא בָּ֖א בִּשְׂכָרֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- bə·‘ā·lāw ‘im·mōw lō yə·šal·lêm ’im- śā·ḵîr hū bā biś·ḵā·rōw
verses.literal: If the owner was present no restitution is required If the animal . . . was rented the fee covers the loss

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יְפַתֶּ֣ה אִ֗ישׁ בְּתוּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ אֹרָ֖שָׂה וְשָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑הּ מָהֹ֛ר יִמְהָרֶ֥נָּה לּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yə·p̄at·teh ’îš bə·ṯū·lāh ’ă·šer lō- ’ō·rā·śāh wə·šā·ḵaḇ ‘im·māh mā·hōr yim·hā·ren·nāh lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and sleeps with her he must pay the full dowry . . . for her to be his wife

verses.original: אִם־ מָאֵ֧ן יְמָאֵ֛ן אָבִ֖יהָ לְתִתָּ֣הּ ל֑וֹ כֶּ֣סֶף יִשְׁקֹ֔ל כְּמֹ֖הַר הַבְּתוּלֹֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- mā·’ên yə·mā·’ên ’ā·ḇî·hā lə·ṯit·tāh lōw ke·sep̄ yiš·qōl kə·mō·har hab·bə·ṯū·lōṯ
verses.literal: If her father absolutely refuses . . . to give her to him the man still must pay an amount comparable to the bridal price of a virgin

verses.original: מְכַשֵּׁפָ֖ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mə·ḵaš·šê·p̄āh lō ṯə·ḥay·yeh
verses.literal: You must not allow a sorceress to live

verses.original: כָּל־ שֹׁכֵ֥ב עִם־ בְּהֵמָ֖ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- bə·hê·māh mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever lies with an animal must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: זֹבֵ֥חַ לָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יָֽחֳרָ֑ם בִּלְתִּ֥י לַיהוָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zō·ḇê·aḥ lā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·ḥo·rām bil·tî Yah·weh lə·ḇad·dōw
verses.literal: If anyone sacrifices to any god other than the LORD alone he must be set apart for destruction

verses.original: וְגֵ֥ר לֹא־ תוֹנֶ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִלְחָצֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־ גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡêr lō- ṯō·w·neh wə·lō ṯil·ḥā·ṣen·nū kî- ḡê·rîm hĕ·yî·ṯem bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt

verses.original: כָּל־ אַלְמָנָ֥ה וְיָת֖וֹם לֹ֥א תְעַנּֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’al·mā·nāh wə·yā·ṯō·wm lō ṯə·‘an·nūn
verses.literal: You must not mistreat any widow or orphan

verses.original: אִם־ עַנֵּ֥ה תְעַנֶּ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־ צָעֹ֤ק יִצְעַק֙ אֵלַ֔י שָׁמֹ֥עַ אֶשְׁמַ֖ע צַעֲקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘an·nêh ṯə·‘an·neh ’ō·ṯōw kî ’im- ṣā·‘ōq yiṣ·‘aq ’ê·lay šā·mō·a‘ ’eš·ma‘ ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: If you do mistreat them . . . - . . . and they cry out to Me in distress I will surely hear . . . their cry

verses.original: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְהָרַגְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בֶּחָ֑רֶב וְהָי֤וּ נְשֵׁיכֶם֙ אַלְמָנ֔וֹת וּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם יְתֹמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·rāh ’ap·pî wə·hā·raḡ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem be·ḥā·reḇ wə·hā·yū nə·šê·ḵem ’al·mā·nō·wṯ ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem yə·ṯō·mîm
verses.literal: My anger will be kindled and I will kill you with the sword then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless

verses.original: אִם־ כֶּ֣סֶף׀ תַּלְוֶ֣ה אֶת־ עַמִּ֗י אֶת־ הֶֽעָנִי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹא־ תִהְיֶ֥ה ל֖וֹ כְּנֹשֶׁ֑ה לֹֽא־ תְשִׂימ֥וּן עָלָ֖יו נֶֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ke·sep̄ tal·weh ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- he·‘ā·nî ‘im·māḵ lō- ṯih·yeh lōw kə·nō·šeh lō- ṯə·śî·mūn ‘ā·lāw ne·šeḵ
verses.literal: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor you must not act as a creditor to him you are not to charge . . . him interest

verses.original: אִם־ חָבֹ֥ל תַּחְבֹּ֖ל שַׂלְמַ֣ת רֵעֶ֑ךָ עַד־ בֹּ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ תְּשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥā·ḇōl taḥ·bōl śal·maṯ rê·‘e·ḵā ‘aḏ- bō haš·še·meš tə·šî·ḇen·nū lōw
verses.literal: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as collateral . . . return it to him by sunset . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִ֤וא כְסוּתָה לְבַדָּ֔הּ הִ֥וא שִׂמְלָת֖וֹ לְעֹר֑וֹ בַּמֶּ֣ה יִשְׁכָּ֔ב וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־ יִצְעַ֣ק אֵלַ֔י וְשָׁמַעְתִּ֖י כִּֽי־ חַנּ֥וּן אָֽנִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hî ḵə·sū·ṯå̄h lə·ḇad·dāh hî śim·lā·ṯōw lə·‘ō·rōw bam·meh yiš·kāḇ wə·hā·yāh kî- yiṣ·‘aq ’ê·lay wə·šā·ma‘·tî kî- ḥan·nūn ’ā·nî
verses.literal: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body What else will he sleep in . . . And if he cries out to Me I will hear for I am compassionate

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א תְקַלֵּ֑ל וְנָשִׂ֥יא בְעַמְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א תָאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō ṯə·qal·lêl wə·nā·śî ḇə·‘am·mə·ḵā lō ṯā·’ōr
verses.literal: You must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people . . .

verses.original: מְלֵאָתְךָ֥ וְדִמְעֲךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנֶ֖יךָ תִּתֶּן־ לִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mə·lê·’ā·ṯə·ḵā wə·ḏim·‘ă·ḵā lō ṯə·’a·ḥêr bə·ḵō·wr bā·ne·ḵā tit·ten- lî
verses.literal: You must not hold back offerings from your granaries or vats You are to give Me the firstborn of your sons

verses.original: כֵּֽן־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְשֹׁרְךָ֖ לְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עִם־ אִמּ֔וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י תִּתְּנוֹ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kên- ta·‘ă·śeh lə·šō·rə·ḵā lə·ṣō·ne·ḵā šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm yih·yeh ‘im- ’im·mōw bay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî tit·tə·nōw- lî
verses.literal: You shall do likewise with your cattle and your sheep Let them stay with their mothers for seven days but on the eighth day you are to give them to Me

verses.original: וְאַנְשֵׁי־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְי֣וּן לִ֑י וּבָשָׂ֨ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֤ה טְרֵפָה֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ לַכֶּ֖לֶב תַּשְׁלִכ֥וּן אֹתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’an·šê- qō·ḏeš tih·yūn lî ū·ḇā·śār baś·śā·ḏeh ṭə·rê·p̄āh lō ṯō·ḵê·lū lak·ke·leḇ taš·li·ḵūn ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: You are to be My holy people You must not eat the meat of a mauled animal found in the field you are to throw it to the dogs
